title: The cut: slim packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md under every existing pin, then run the regen chain
action: Rewrite packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md per docs/history/agents-block-diet/plan.md's cut budget. KEEP: all 15 numbered critical rules (same numbers, same order), the unnumbered native-wait pointer line, every section heading, and FULL text for critical rules 1, 5, 6, 11 and the whole Guardrails section (D3 -- bee-hive/SKILL.md defers back here, so a defer-out builds the R6 loop). CUT: (1) Startup steps 3/5/6 which restate the session preamble and step 7 which self-declares optional -- collapse to short steps, each leaving a one-line pointer naming the rule and its home (R5); (2) the Gate-4/bypass paragraph body, which already points at bee-bypass-gate and routing-and-contracts.md; (3) the restated elaboration in rules 2, 12, 13, 15, each of which already ends in a terminal pointer; (4) the Communication bullet list down to Open/Body/Close plus the pre-send check; (5) the planning-time D1/D3/D4 + decision-0009 conditionals in the docs/history/ working-files comment. Every pinned string in CONTEXT.md D4 must survive character-for-character -- especially the native-wait pointer, whose phrase and routing-and-contracts.md must stay on ONE line and stay unnumbered. THEN run the regen chain in order: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply (this is what re-renders the repo-root AGENTS.md between its BEE:START/BEE:END markers and updates .bee/onboarding.json's agents_block hash -- never hand-edit either), then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write. Confirm the prose OUTSIDE the markers survives the merge. R82: run no test suites; MAIN verifies at close.

truths: All 15 numbered critical rules are present, numbered 1..15 in order.
Critical rules 1, 5, 6, 11 and the Guardrails section are byte-unchanged from before the cut.
Every pinned string listed in CONTEXT.md D4 is present (or, for the two banned-phrase sets, still absent).
The managed block in the repo-root AGENTS.md is byte-identical to the template, with exactly one ordered marker pair, and the header above the markers is unchanged.
The block is <= 12000 bytes, or the miss is reported with the reason.
prohibitions: Do NOT change any rule's meaning, add an exception, or remove one.
Do NOT delete a why-clause from a safety rule (D6).
Do NOT delete a section heading (R5).
Do NOT hand-edit AGENTS.md or .bee/onboarding.json -- only the regen chain writes them.

verify: node scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs && node scripts/tests/test_doctrine_parity.mjs && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check
